<DOCSTRING>
Tests the max age functionality of the serializer.

Args:
    serializer (object): The serializer object used for serialization and deserialization.
    value (any): The value to be serialized.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp when the value was serialized.
    freeze (object): The freeze object used to simulate time passage.

Returns:
    void: This method asserts conditions and does not return a value directly.
</DOCSTRING>
